text_block_list.text:
After I finish up my duties one day,
I come
across Fuji Kiseki speaking
with one of her
young dormmates.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is strange. Why did you call me out
here to this deserted place?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What's going on, my dear pony?

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text: Well, um, Fuji...

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm ready. I want to tell you how I
feel.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I'm ready to listen.
My heart is
open.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text: Fuji, you... you mean the world to me!

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text:
You've always been there, just a year
ahead of me, a goal for me to
chase and
maybe one day even catch up to... And
when I did...

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text: We'd be shoulder to shoulder, running as equals... running together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My dear, p—

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text: So... it's just so hard... that I...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, now. Look at me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I heard from the director about this being
your last day at the
academy... and about
your injury.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even among the students here, you were
gifted with a remarkable
talent. I knew you
would become a formidable opponent one
day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You were unwavering in your training,
practicing harder than all
others. That's
why it pains me to see you go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've always been a fan of yours.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to say...

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text:
I wanted so badly to keep running... to
keep winning, and then one
day...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: One day?

text_block_list.name: Junior Student
text_block_list.text:
I know this is a big ask,
but I want you to
carry on my dream. My
dream as a racer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I'll hold it with me always. It'll
be like we're running
together, forever and
ever.

As the sun sets, a faint crying can be
heard, until finally, the young
racer leaves
with a smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, it appears you've stumbled upon my
secret. I know you're there,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There come times like that when a
precious student must leave the
academy.
It makes me feel so helpless, unable to
change anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How can I bring joy to someone whose
dream was shattered? Even her
parting
smile was filled with sadness.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She entrusted her dreams as a racer to
me...

Just now, I'm reminded that Fuji Kiseki
told me she once let go of her
dream to be
on the big stage, choosing instead to
become a racer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mine? My dream is crystal clear—it's to
bring joy to all and make
miracles happen.

As soon as the words leave her lips, she
falls silent. With a curious
expression, she
looks deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I seem to have lost myself. Fuji
Kiseki would put on a big
smile precisely
at this moment!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you promise me you'll keep
secret what you saw here today.
It'll be
just between you and me, all right?

Clandestine promise made, Fuji Kiseki
gives the biggest smile she can
muster.
